tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/

na ma sh+shaṃ wa rā ya/ gsang ba mchog gi pho brang du/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /gcig pu rab tu che ba'i lha/ /rtag tu bzhugs pa de la 'dud/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi/ /lha mo de la'ang gus btud nas/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi/ /sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i 'dir 'jug bya/ /da ni 'dir dpal mkha' 'gro'i rgyud kyi rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par 'dod pa la de bshad par bya ste/ de la dang por zhing skyong rnams la gtor ma sbyin te rang gnas su btang*/ oṃ hūṃ/ zhes bstan byin gyis rlabs/ 'og nas 'byung ba gtor ma ltar nang mchod byin rlabs bya/ oṃ hrīḥswāhā/ lan gnyis kyis kha dang lag pa byin gyis rlabs/ g.yon pa'i lag mthil dang mthe'u chung nas brtsams te/ sor mo rnams kyi rtsa ba la/ oṃ baṃ haṃ yoṃ hriṃ moṃ hraiṃ hriṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ sor mo lnga bsdus pa'i mdzub mo dang*/ mthe bong la sogs pa'i sen mo la/ oṃ ha na ma hi swāhā hūṃ bau ṣa ṭa hūṃ hūṃ ha phaṭa haṃ rnams 'khod byin gyis rlabs pa'i nang mchod lag mthil g.yas su bzhag ste/ srin lag g.yon pas chos 'byung 'bri/ 'bru gsum lan mang du brjod la/ yan lag lnga dang*/ mchod rdzas sogs la bsangs gtor bya/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi hūṃ/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān ut+pa ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra re khe hūṃ/ oṃ hrīḥswāhā/ oṃ arka bi ma le swāhā/ oṃ tsan+d+ra bi ma le swāhā/ zhes pa rnams kyi maṇ+ḍal bya/ rdo rje'i phyag rgyas reg cing*/ bhur bhu wa swaḥ zhes byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ āḥs+thā naṃ me rak+ṣa hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.at+ma naṃ me rak+ṣa hūṃ/ oṃ āḥyo gaṃ me k+ṣa hūṃ/ bar 'dir skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya rnams bya/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya gnas drug tu reg la/ oṃ hā sogs brjod pas go cha bcings/ spro na/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro = sogs sho lo ka gnyis dang*/ srid pa'i rgya mtshor yongs bying ba/

/yang dag yongs su sgrol mkhas pa'i/ /bla ma dam pa'i drin gang gis/ /bdag la ye shes 'di bskyed 'dud/ / ces phyag byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas la gtor ma 'bul bar bya'o/ / rang skad cig gis he ru ka phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ snying gar paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ nag po/ oṃ a ā= nas ha k+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ gi nā da las yi ge'i 'phreng ba spros/ lus kyi stod bar smad rnams su/ sngo dmar dkar ba'i 'phreng bas g.yon skor du dkris/ de las khams gsum du gtogs pa thams cad 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs spros te srid pa gsum gyi bgegs thams cad bcom par gyur/ rang gi spyi bo dang*/ dpral pa dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying ga rnams kyi thad ka'i nam mkha' la rim pas/ shrī he ru ka zhes pa'i yi ge bzhi kha dog sngon po'o/ /shrī he ru ko3 haṃ/ gzugs kyi phung po la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba'i phung po la ni rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /'du shes kyi phung po la ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go /'du byed kyi phung po la ni rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po la ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /phung po lnga po thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid ni shrī he ru ka rdo rje'o/ /mig gnyis la ni gti mug rdo rje'o/ /rna ba gnyis la ni zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna dag la ni phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /lce la ni 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /lus la ni ser sna rdo rje'o/ /skye mched thams cad la ni dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /sa'i khams la ni ltung byed ma'o/ /chu'i khams la ni gsod byed ma'o/ /me'i khams la ni 'gugs byed ma'o/ /rlung gi khams la ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go /nam mkha'i khams la ni pad+ma dra ba can no/ /dag pa gsum dang phung khams byin gyis rlabs pa de dag ni/ rten byin gyis rlabs pa zhes bya'o/ /

sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i se gol gdab cing*/ oṃ sum bha ni sum bha kā yi kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa wā tsi kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya tsa ra si maṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān/ badz+ra dz+nyā ni kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags rnams nag po ljang khu/ dmar po/ ser po'i 'od kyis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar du khyab pa/ 'og tu raṃ las nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gyis mtshan pa'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyogs mtshams su sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi phyogs kyi mdog can/ steng du rdo rje'i bla re dang gur/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje rtse lnga pa ljang khu'i mda'i dra ba rnams su gyur/ mtshams rngam dang bcas pa'i sum bha tshar gnyis brjod / sngags re re'i 'od zer las byung ba khwa gdong ma la sogs pa'i sgo ma bzhi/ gnyis gnyis 'dres pa'i 'od zer las byung ba gshin rje brtan ma la sogs pa'i mtshams ma bzhi rnams tho ba dang rang 'dra'i phur bu thogs pa spros/ oṃ bigh+nān ā na ya dzaḥ zhes bskul bas/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkugahūṃ ra ba'i phyi rol du 'brub khung mes gang ba byung ba rnams su bcug /phur bus spyi bor gdab/ oṃ gha gha sogs brjod/ tho bas brdungs/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra sogs brjod/ bgegs rnams stong pa'i dbyings su sbyangs/ /pho nya mo rnams ra ba la thim/ /'od zer gyi thig le phyir 'phros pas/ 'khor lo dang pad+ma dang rdo rje dang me'i ra ba zlum po rnams su gyur/ 'og gi hūṃ zhu bas rdo rje phra mos bar mtshams med par gtams/ bdag dang 'gro ba thams cad kun nas bgegs dang bral ba'o/ /de dag ni bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'o/ / maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du tshom bu dgod cing*/ oṃ badz+ra ku ru swāhā/ oṃ sun+da rī swāhā/

oṃ pri ya ud ta ma swāhā/ oṃ da ma kā tā rā swāhā/ oṃ bi lā sa badz+ra swāhā/ oṃ bud+dha lo tsa ni swāhā/ oṃ mā ma kī swāhā/ oṃ pan+ṭa ra wa si swāhā/ oṃ tā rā swāhā/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun du spyan drangs/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus kyi me tog gi steng du lha tshogs rnams rang rang gi rnam pa dang*/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i rol pas bzhugs/ shar du kun mdzes ma sngon mo/ byang du dkar mchog ma ljang khu/ nub tu shin tu rtse ma dmar mo/ lho ru rol pa'i rdo rje ma ser mo/ bzhi char yang snyim pa rin po che dang mchod pa sna tshogs kyis bkang nas/ gtso bo la stob pa/ mer spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo/ bden bral du mā ma kī sngon mo rdo rje/ rlung du gos dkar mo dmar mo pad+ma dbang ldan du sgrol ma ljang khu ut+pal/ bzhi char yang g.yas rang rtags dang*/ g.yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ lha mo brgyad po thams cad zhi zhing sgeg pa/ rol pa'i 'dug stangs can no/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gyis mgron la bsang gtor bya'o/ / oṃ pra wa ra sat+ka ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ ar+ghaṃ= oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ snying ga'i hūṃ las byung ba'i rig ma bcu drug gis mchod par gyur/ oṃ wī ni badz+ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa nas oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces so/ / rkang pa zhe brgyad pa'i rkang ba re re'i mgo ru oṃ re dang*/ 'jug tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa re sbyar bas bstod de/ oṃ na ma shrī badz+ra ḍā ka ma hā bī ra bi ra shwa rā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa zhes pa nas/ oṃ grasta bā ta pra bā ta hā ma te hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i bar ro/ /yab yum gyi snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar bas nang mchod 'bul/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang shā bā ri pa dang*/

/ mai tri pa dang rgya gar phyag na dang*/ /pad+ma rdo rje dza ya s+ya na dang*/ /sum lo grags rgyal sa paṇa skyob pa dpal/ /rgyal tsha chos dbang mang mkhar lo tsā dang*/ /bag ston tshul rgyal ngag dbang byang seng ba/ /sa bzang 'phags pa mkhan chen seng ge dpal/ /byams pa gling pa rdo rje gdan pa dang*/ /rgya ston byang dbang rje btsun grol mchog dang*/ /byams pa lhun grub rnams la gus pas mchod/ / ces pa 'di rje btsun grol mchog gi gsan yig ltar bkod pa yin/ rgyal tsha chos dbang mang mkhar lo tsā ba/ /blo chen ye shes mgon dang dar ma bzang*/ /grags chen spang khang ba dang rin brtson pa/ /mkhan chen byang ser theg chen chos rje dang*/ /brag thog bsod bzang 'jigs med rdo rje gdan pa/ dpa' bo dang*/ rgya ston man= gong bzhin no/ /yang na sum lo mkhas pa sa mu dra pa dang*/ /seng ge rgyal mtshan yar lungs lo tsā ba/ /rong ba shes seng skyi ston grags rgyal dang*/ /kun mkhyen chen po slob dpon chos grags dpal/ /mkhan chen byang seng = sogs gong bzhin/ nye brgyud ni/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /shā bā ri pa sems kyi rje grol mchog go mdud grol dang*/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus lha dbang grags pa ste/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i bla ma rnams la mchod/ / ces so/ / kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /'gro don rab tu sgrub pa po/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'dir 'byung ba/ /dpal sdom khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs ye shes chen pos g.yogs/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /thugs rje khro ba drag chen po/ /dpal sdom khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa dang byed du bcug dang yi rang ba'i/ /sdig pa ma lus skyon kun bcom pa yi/ /spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slar yang ni/ /mi byed pa yi sdom pa bzung bar bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang*/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis bsngags pa'i dge ba gang*/ /de dag kun la bdag gis rjes yi

rang*/ /byang chub yang dag yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /rgyal ba dkon mchog la sogs gsum po la/ /dngos po kun gyis bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de bzhin du/ /bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyi/ / lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra satwa gu ru pā de bh+yaḥ sarba sa twa u pa kā ra ṇi ya swāhā/ zhes me tog gtor/ tshogs zhing gi dkyil 'khor 'khor bcas rang la thim pa'am/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra muḥhūṃ/ zhes gshegs su gsol/ de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom ste/ bsod nams tshogs gsog go / oṃ sarba dharmaḥshū n+ya swa bhā wa shū n+yo3 haṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ de lta bu'i sngags kyi don bsgom pa ni ye shes tshogs gsog go / stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid nā da dmar skya nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ de las thig le/ de las zla byed/ de las mgo bo/ de las ha/ de las ū yig grub pa'i tshul gyis hūṃ yig ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ de dang lhan cig grub pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re phyi rol 'khor lo dang pad+ma dang rdo rje dang me'-i drwa bas bskor ba thams cad kyang dbyibs zlum po'o/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo de'i nang 'og gi char yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum raṃ dang 'bar bas mtshan pa/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po baṃ dang bum pas mtshan pa/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi laṃ dang rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ suṃ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ kha dog bzhi dang zur bzhi pa/ rtse mo brgyad pa la sum gyis mtshan pa/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ/ de yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje shar nag

byang ljang nub dmar lho ser lte ba dkar ba 'byung ba rnams zhu zhing sla ba'i ngo bor gyur pas ri rab 'og gi cha la song la/ 'byung ba bzhi zhu ba rnams sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gzhal med khang chen po rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi la gnas shing dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba/ chos 'byung gi phyag rgya'i nang du chud pa kho na phyi nang du rim pa bzhi las/ pho brang nang ma gsum zlum po/ phyi ma gru bzhi'o/ /pho brang dang po lhan cig skyes pa'i sku'i 'khor lo ni/ nag po dang sngon po'i rtsig pa rim pa gnyis dang ldan pa/ chos 'byung zur gsum pa'i nang du chud pa/ pho brang gnyis pa chos kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor ni/ nag dmar dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ chos 'byung zur bzhi pa'i nang du chud pa/ pho brang gsum pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor sngo ser/ dmar ljang ba'i rtsig pa rim pa bzhi dang ldan pa/ chos 'byung zur lnga pa'i nang du chud pa/ pho brang bzhi pa sprul pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor ni/ sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ chos 'byung zur drug pa'i nang du chud pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor dang po'i dbus su sna tshogs thig le'i 'khor lo pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa ste/ de'i lte bar nyi ma la 'jigs byed chen po dang dus kyi mtshan ma'o/ /de'i phyir rol du rdo rje'i 'khor lo sngo nag mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du snying po'i 'khor lo dmar ser rin po che'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du yon tan gyi 'khor lo dkar dmar rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol bskal pa bzang po'i lha'i snam bu'o/ /sgo'i phyi rol du nam mkha'i khor yug la gnas pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar nas g.yon skor gyis gtum drag

tshang tshing can/ 'bar ba 'khrigs pa'i keng rus/ 'jigs sde/ dbang ldan nas g.yon skor gyis/ ha ha rgod pa/ dpal gyi nags/ mun pa drag po/ ki li ki li'i sgra sgrog pa rnams so/ /de dag na gnas pa'i shing chen po brgyad ni/ shi ri sha a shwat+tha/ kaṃ ka la/ tsu ta/ n+ya gro dha/ ka rañja/ la ta par+ṣa/ pā ra ṭhi pa'o/ /phyogs skyong ba brgyad ni/ dbang po/ gnod sbyin/ klu'i dbang po/ gshin rje'i bdag po/ 'byung po'i bdag po/ sreg za'i bdag po/ srin po'i bdag po/ rlung gi bdag pa'o/ /klu chen po brgyad ni/ nor rgyas/ 'jog po/ stobs kyi rgyu/ pad+ma/ pad+ma chen po/ hu lu hu lu/ rigs ldan/ dung skyong ngo*/ /sprin gyi bdag po brgyad ni/ sgra sgrogs/ 'ur sgrogs/ drag po/ 'khyil pa/ 'thug po/ gang ba/ char 'bebs/ gtum po'o/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i dbus su/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor 'dam skyes sngon po'i mdog can pad+ma'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du rlung gi 'khor lo sngo ljang ngam sna tshogs pa'i mdog can 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du sa'i 'khor lo ser po ral gri'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du bskal pa bzang po'i lha'i snam bu'o/ /sgo'i phyi rol du me'i khor yug la gnas pa'i dur khrod brgyad ni/ gsod byed/ kun tu skrag byed/ 'jigs chen/ 'jigs byed/ skrod byed/ sdang byed/ lkugs byed/ rengs byed do/ /shing brgyad ni/ go yu/ star ka /nā ri la/ se 'bru/ bil ba/ skyu ru ra/ bidz+nyā/ rak+ṣa'o/ /phyogs skyong ma brgyad ni/ dbang mo/ gnod sbyin mo/ chu lha mo/ gshin rje mo/ 'byung mo/ drang srong mo/ srin mo/ rlung gi chung ma'o/ /dkyil 'khor gsum pa'i dbus su/ me'i 'khor lo dmar po sna tshogs rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du chu'i 'khor lo dkar po thod pa'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi 'khor lo ljang khu'am khra bo mgo bo'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/

de'i phyi rol du bskal pa bzang po'i lha'i snam bu'o/ /sgo'i phyi rol du chu'i khor yug la gnas pa'i dur khrod brgyad ni/ byis pa shi ba/ lhag ma za ba/ mi bzad pa'i g.yul/ mche ba kun/ du ba mun nag nang gi me/ ha ha'i sgra/ sgra chen po'o/ /shing brgyad ni/ tsan dan/ ga pur/ dzā ti/ e la/ nā ga ge sar/ tsam pa ka kun tu ru/ lha'i shing ngo*/ 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad ni/ nyi ma me 'bar ba 'dzin pa/ bsil pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ sa'i bu chu gri 'dzin pa/ ri bong can skyes mdung ring 'dzin pa/ bla ma spu gri 'dzin pa/ ngan spong gi bu brag ri 'dzin pa/ nyi ma'i bu glog 'dzin pa/ lha min mgo bo mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa ste thams cad kyang bzhin shin tu khros pa'o/ /grub pa'i skyes bu brgyad ni/ ral gri/ mig sman/ ril bu/ rkang byug bcud len/ mchil lham/ dngul chu/ sa 'og thob pa rnams so/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi pa'i dbus su thugs kyi 'khor lo nag po keng rus kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po zhags pa'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du sku'i 'khor lo dkar dmar sngo ba'i mdog can mu khyud la lcags kyu'i 'phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /de'i phyi rol du bskal pa bzang po'i lha'i snam bu'o/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i phyi rol du rlung gi khor yug la gnas pa'i dur khrod brgyad ni/ tshig pa/ ma tshig pa/ dum bur gyur pa/ ma gtubs pa/ 'jigs su rung ba/ 'jigs par byed pa/ gsal shing gis phug pa/ steng nas btags pa'o/ /shing brgyad ni/ shal+ma li/ mya ngan med pa/ yongs 'du/ u dum+ba ra/ ḍom+ba ri/ gam+bha ri/ rgya shug ba ru ra'o/ /'jig rten skyong ba ni/ dmyal srung chen po brgyad do/ /de la gzhal med khang rim pa re re'i nang du chud pa'i 'khor lo rim pa gsum gsum ste/ bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang so sor rtsibs sum cu rtsa drug rtsa drug dang bcas pa/

gzhal med khang rnams kyang pha gu dang*/ ka thung dang*/ gser gyis snam bu dang*/ dra phyed dang*/ shar bu dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng na ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ ri dwags kyis rtse mo brgyan pa/ nang gi lha snam shar sngo/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus dkar ba/ steng thog rim par phub pas dbus phyur bur gyur pa/ rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis mdzes pa/ gzhal med khang phyi ma'i nang gi grwa bzhir bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dur khrod rim pa bzhi po rnams kyang re re bzhin/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ me dang*/ sprin dang*/ chu dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten brgyad brgyad rnams dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma/ ro dang ro langs dang*/ bya dang gcan gzan dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi 'khor gyis yongs su gang ba/ mchod pa'i yo byad rnams dang*/ grub pa'i rdzas kyis nye bar brgyan pa/ phyi rol na rdo rje'i 'phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor chen po dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa phyi nang kun tu 'od gsal ba mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa rgyan gyi rnam pa mchog tu bkra ba du mas mdzes par gyur/ nang gi lha'i gnas rnams las/ gtso bo'i pad+ma'i 'dab ma nyer bzhi dang*/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor so so'i sgo mtshams rnams su ro'i gdan/ bskal bzang gi snam bu la zla ba'i gdan rnams so/ /de dag ni rten gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ a ā

nas aṃ aḥnyis 'gyur g.yon skor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs so gnyis kyis mtshan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du ka kha nas ha k+ṣa ya ra la wa ḍa ḍ+ḍha nyis 'gyur g.yon skor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed brgyad cus mtshan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi dbus su nam mkha'i hūṃ yig zhugs/ de las 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi lha tshogs rnams spros te/ 'gro ba thams cad de'i bdag nyid du byas nas slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ yang 'od 'phros thog ma med pa nas grub pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad phyogs bcu nas spyan drangs te hūṃ la thim pa ni bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las sku yongs su rdzogs pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /de yang rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po/ dkar ljang dmar ser ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa 'dzin pa/ lhag ma g.yas bzhi cang te'u/ gri gug dgra sta/ rtse gsum/ g.yon bzhi kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thod pa zhags pa tshangs mgo rnams 'dzin pa/ byis pa'i rgyan gyi brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yon pa bskum pas 'jigs byed dang*/ g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ smad g.yogs stag gi pags pa'i sha thabs grol ba= nas 'phro ba dang bcas pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin no/ /thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig go /de yan chad ni bsnyen pa'o/ /yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa byāṃ las byung ba'i nor bu'i rtse mor byāṃ dmar ser gyis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' khams mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas pad ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa d+yāṃ las byung ba'i ze 'bru'i rtser mor d+yāṃ dkar ser gyis mtshan pa/

gnyis ka'i bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yab kyi lte ba dang*/ yum gyi mgrin par/ oṃ bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi thugs ka dang*/ yum gyi dpral par/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi mgrin pa dang yum gyi lte bar/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dzā la sam+ba raṃ swāhā/ yab kyi dpral pa dang yum gyi thugs kar/ oṃ hri ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sngags rnams phan tshun reg cing*/ yab yum gyi rjes su chags pa'i snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskul te yab kyi zhal du zhugs lha mo'i pad+ma son pa na/ yab yum gnyis ka bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo/ 'od kyi thig le'i gong bur zhu bar gyur/ nye ba'i bsnyen pa'o/ / de nas snying rje dang byams pa dang dga' ba dang*/ btang snyoms kyi rang bzhin thig le las byung ba'i mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa lha mo drug tshan bzhi rnams rang rang gi gnas kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la 'dug nas bzhengs par bskul ba ni/ mnga' bdag nyi ma re rer 'gro ba mgron 'bod na/ khyod ni ci yi phyir na stong pa nyid la bzhugs/ / bzhengs shig bzhengs shig bdag ni snying rje'i rang bzhin te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bde chen bdag la 'dod pa mdzod/ /gson zhig gson zhig gzhan gyi dgongs pa nub/ / 'jig rten phyugs gang shi ba bzhin du gyur/ /bdag gi pad+ma rgyas pa la 'dod mdzod/ /de ltar 'jig rten kun bder 'gyur bar byos/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag la rol zhig rol/ /lhan skyes rang bzhin brjod du med pa thob/ /'jig rten sems can gzhan ni rmongs gyur pas/ /ji ltar khyod ni stong pa don med 'gyur/ /khyod ni chos rnams kun gyi byed po ste/ /ci phyir lhan skyes rang bzhin 'gro med bzhugs/ /bdag la mchog gi don gyi 'dod pa mdzod/

/ji ltar khyod ni 'jig rten rnams mthun bzhud/ / ces bskul nas/ lha mo rnams thig le la thim/ thig le de nyid hūṃ sngon po las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūṃ ljang sngon gyis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ āḥkā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa hoḥ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sngags 'di 'don bzhin par bzhengs pa na/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyang skad cig gis rdzogs par blta'o/ /de yang dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte ba la zla ba dang nyi ma dang dus me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ 'jigs byed chen po dang dus mtshan mo'i gdan la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog g.yon nag g.yas ljang ba'i phyed gzugs la nyi ma bye ba'i 'od ltar 'bar ba'i gzi brjid kyi phung po can zhal bcu bdun phyag bdun cu rtsa drug pa/ rtsa zhal sku lus dang mtshungs pa'i mdog can/ rtsa zhal gyi steng gi zhal gsum dang*/ kun gyi steng gi zhal gcig ste bzhi ni bung ba ltar gnag cing ches khros pa/ g.yon zhal brtsegs ma bzhi ljang khu/ rgyab zhal brtsegs ma bzhi dmar po/ g.yas zhal brtsegs ma bzhi ser po/ zhal re re zhing dmar zhing bkra la rab tu 'khrug pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ zhal thams cad kyang rnam par 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ kun gyi mdun ma'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ thams cad kyi tha ma'i phyag gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa stod g.yogs su bsnams pa ste rtsa ba'i phyag bzhi'o/ /lhag ma sprul phyag bdun cu rtsa gnyis ni/ /dang po g.yas g.yon ral gri phub chen bsnams/ /gnyis pa dag gis mdung ring mche ba 'dzin/ /gsum pa mdung rtse gsum dang gtun shing ngo*/ /bzhi pa dgra sta zhags pa ste/ lnga pa gri gug thod khrag go /drug pa mda' bo che dang gzhu/

/bdun pa gsal zhing kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /brgyad po tho ba po ti dang*/ /dgu pa 'khor lo phub chung dang*/ /bcu pa cang te'u sdigs mdzub can/ /bcu gcig chu gri g.yer kha'i phreng*/ /bcu gnyis dbyug gu rtse gcig lu gu brgyud/ /bcu gsum mtshon cha rtse gcig brag ri'o/ /bcu bzhi dung dkar dur khrod rdul/ /bco lnga zangs dung bho kaṃ dang*/ /bcu drug dbyug rtse gsum dang ḍha ka ste/ /bcu bdun rma bya'i mjug sgro pags rlon no/ /bco brgyad bya rog gshog sgro skra thag dang*/ /bcu dgu skra'i pir ro bsreg bskul ba'i shing*/ /nyi shu me thab ga da'i dbyug /nyer gcig ri bo phug rings dang*/ /nyer gnyis dbyug to mi mgo dang*/ /nyer gsum me long keng rus dang*/ /nyer bzhi pi wang zor ba'o/ /nyer lnga rkang pa'i mgo dang mig /nyer drug lag mgo mkhal ma ste/ /nyer bdun glo ba snye ma dang*/ /nyer brgyad rgyu ma spen pa dang*/ /nyer dgu sgra gcan phur bu'o/ /sum cu lcags sgrog bi dza pur/ /so gcig gdos dang sog le ste/ /so gnyis du bhu sa dang khab/ /so gsum nya dol pags pa slud bu bshus/ /so bzhi mgo med ro dang char 'bebs sprin/ /so lnga 'bar ba'i mar nag ljon shing ste/ /so drug 'jigs byed che gzugs lcags kyu bsnams/ /zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo gan rkyal du gnas pa'i nu steng dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu gnas pa'i rna ba g.yon pa'i steng nas brdzis pa/ zhes pa tsam mam/ yang na/ zhabs bco brgyad kyi g.yas dgu brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo gan rkyal du mnan pa'i steng dang*/ g.yon dgu brkyang bas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu gnas pa'i rna ba g.yon pa mnan pa'i steng du/ g.yas pas khyab 'jug drag po dang*/ tshangs pa nyi ma me dang ni/ /dbang po rlung dang bden bral dang*/ /gnod sbyin ji lta'i rim pas so/ /g.yon pas gshin rje 'dod lha dang*/

/zla ba chu lha nor rgyas dang*/ /sa dang tshogs kyi bdag po dang*/ /smin drug bu dang 'khor sgyur rnams/ /gnon zhing 'jigs par mdzad pa yin/ / zhes so/ / smad g.yogs stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor 'khor lo la gnas pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pa dang*/ ral pa'i mdun ngos su sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ dbu re re la rdo rje nag po'i 'phreng ba la brgyus pa'i mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs bcings pa/ /mi mgo khrag 'dzag brgya'i do shal can/ phyag rgya drug dag dpung rgyan dang*/ zhabs gdub dang*/ 'og pag la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing*/ sku lus ba spu'i 'phreng ba can/ sku'i tshigs thams cad la bde bas brlan pa/ sprul pa'i he ru ka sna tshogs pa rnam par 'phro ba dang bcas pa'o/ / de ni sgrub pa'o/ / de la 'khyud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ drag mo chen mo zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yab la khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas bzhis zangs gri/ sta re ḍā ma ru tri shu la/ g.yon bzhis ka pā la/ 'ching byed/ mkha' dbyug tshangs mgo rnams 'dzin pa/ phyag tha ma gnyis spyi bo'i steng du skye gnas kyi phyag rgya yongs su bskor ba/ dmar ser sngo ljang ba'i zhal bzhi dang ldan pa/ gcer bu ba spu langs shing rdul dang ldan pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ yan lag thams cad la lha rdzas kyi dris nyer bar byugs shing*/ lha rdzas kyi me tog phreng bas klubs pa/ dbu rgyan la zla phyed rdo rjes mdzes pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis yab dpal he ru ka dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ phyag rgya lnga dang thod pa'i cod pan can/

mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang ldan pa/ sprul pa'i rnal 'byor pa dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / de ni sgrub pa chen po'o/ /de yan chad kyis dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin rdzogs so// // sna tshogs thig le'i 'khor lo'i pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad las/ bar bar du 'dab ma re re bor ba'i 'dab ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi la rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ shar nas byang gi bar la/ mkha' 'gro ma dang gzugs can nyid/ /'o byed ma dang gzhan sgyur ma/ /byis bcas ma dang rjes 'jug ma/ /de rnams g.yon nag g.yas ljang khu/ /byang nas nub kyi bar la/ lā ma rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma/ /bzang mo thod pa can ma dang*/ /nag po rgyal pos bskor ma rnams/ /g.yon ljang g.yas dmar rim pas so/ /nub nas lho'i bar la/ dum skyes ma dang dur khrod ma/ /rnam par zhu ma rig byed ma/ /du byed ma dang gar ma rnams/ /g.yon dmar g.yas ni ser ba'o/ /lho nas shar gyi bar la/ gzugs can ma dang 'jigs byed ma/ /gtsud phud ma dang thor tshugs ma/ /ral pa can ma drag mo rnams/ /g.yon ser g.yas ni sngo ba'o/ /thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma/ sgra grol ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon thod khrag dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pa'i stabs kyis me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ /lhag ma gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /de dag gi bar bar gyi 'dab ma rnams la bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i thod pa dang bcas pa nyer bzhi'o/ /de'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams la/ shar nas g.yon skor gyis/ mkha' 'gro ma gzhan lā ma gzhan/ dum skyes ma gzhan gzugs can gzhan/ /rab gtum ma dang gtum mig ma/ /'od ldan ma dang sna chen ma/ /dpa' bo'i blo ma mi'u thung ma/ /lang ka'i mdag mo shing grib ma/

/sa srung 'jigs byed chen mo dang*/ /rlung shugs ma dang chang 'thung ma/ /sngo sangs lha mo rab bzang ma/ /rta sna ma dang bya gdong ma/ /'khor lo'i shugs ma dum skyes ma/ /chang 'tshong 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ /shin tu dpa' mo stobs chen ma/ /'khor los bsgyur ma brtson chen ma/ /gshin rje'i bu mo gshin rje ma/ /skyod byed ma dang skrag byed ma/ / gtum mo dang ni dbyangs can ma/ /'dod grub ma dang 'bar chen mo/ de thams cad kyang sngo nag phyed pa'i gzugs can no/ / 'di dag gi yab rnams mtshan tha dad pa la mos na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs pa bzhi dang*/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la la sogs pa nyer bzhi dang*/ stobs po che/ ye shes mkha' 'gro/ blo brtan brtan pa thar pa ye shes thabs thugs kyi rdo rje zhes pa rnams su bshad la/ /'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi skabs 'dir/ /'og ma rnams kyis rigs 'gre ba'i phyir mtshan tha dad pa ma smos kyang chog go /snying po'o 'khor lo shar nas g.yon skor gyis/ rdo rje 'chang ma mi bskyod ma/ /rin chen gtsug ma rnam snang ma/ /pad+ma gar dbang ma dang don yod ma/ /spyan ma bdag ma gos dkar sgrol ma dang*/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje ma dang de bzhin du/ /sgra dri ro reg chos dbyings rdo rje ma/ /sa snying mo dang nam mkha'i snying po ma/ /phyag rdor ma dang 'jig rten mgon po dang*/ /sgrib pa kun sel kun tu bzang mo dang*/ /rin chen sgrol ma bdag med khro gnyer can/ /ri khrod lo ma can de bzhin du/ /gshin rje mthar byed ma dang shes mthar ma/ /pad mthar ma dang bgegs mthar byed ma dang*/ /mi g.yo ma dang dbyug sngon 'dod rgyal ma/ /stobs chen ma dang gtsug tor gnod mdzes ma/ /thams cad kyang dmar ser phyed pa'i gzugs can no/ /yon tan 'khor lo la/ bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs mo/ /dmangs mo gtum mo khyi 'tshed ma/ /g.yung mo gar ma thod pa can/ /nya pa mo dang smyig ma mkhan/ dung bzo mkhan ma thag ga ma/

/ 'khur ba mkhan mo shing bzo ma/ /phreng ba mkhan mo til mar mkhan/ /de bzhin tshos mkhan mo dang ni/ /srin bal byed mo pho nya mo/ /bshang 'phyag mo dang rtsis mkhan mo/ /chang 'tshong ldum ra'i gnyer ba mo/ /rgyal pos bkrabs ma gshan pa mo/ /so rtsi tshong bar byed ma dang*/ /gser mgar mo dang lcags mgar mo/ / nor bu mkhan ma nags pa mo/ /kla klo o ḍi tshong ba mo/ /rdo bzo ma dang zhing las mo/ /ko pags ma ste rnal 'byor ma'o/ /thams cad kyang dkar dmar phyed pa'i gzugs can no/ /de'i phyi rol skal pa bzang po'i snam bu la/ de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa dang seng ge nas brtsams te/ sangs rgyas glog gi tog gi bar du sangs rgyas nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'o/ /shar sgor khwa gdong ma/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma/ lho sgor phag gdong ma/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma rnams so/ /nam mkha'i 'khor lo la/ mi 'am ci mo dri za mo/ /hu ḍu ka ma pa ṭa ha/ /pi waṃ gling bu mu kun+da/ /rdza rnga gag+ga ri ma dang*/ /cha lang she len+d+ri ka ma/ /glu ma ka ran+ḍa ma ta ma ḍa/ /gar ma sgeg ma ḍ+dha ka ma dang ni/ /trā li sha ra ṇa mo rnga chen mo/ /mo dri rgyud can ma dang mā ru ma/ /na la bā lo ḍ+dhaṃ ba ka ma dang*/ /ḍā ma ru dang bū ṇa bug ma dang*/ /zangs dung ma dang rwa dung ma de bzhin/ /bhu ki dril bu ma dang dril chung ma/ /g.yer kha ma dang ko li ka ma dang*/ dung dkar ma dang dbyangs ldan ma de bzhin/ /'khor ma zhes bya sum cu rtsa drug go /thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po'o/ /yang na sna tshogs par bkra ba'o/ /rlung gi 'khor lo la/ mkha' lding ngang mo bkra ba mo/ /bya rog bya gar sreg pa mo/ /rma bya zangs kyi gtsug phud ma/ /gu da bu li 'jam pa mo/ /phug ron bya rog chen mo dang*/ /ga ṭi ni dang gong ma sreg /ne tso sngags ma bzhad ma dang*/

/bya rgod 'ug pa tsā ṭa ki/ /shing byi'u ma dang ngur pa ma/ /prak+ṣa ra ni kak+ka bi/ /so bya mo dang bi lā ḍi/ /lcug ma'i mgrin dang sha ri kī/ /byi'u rang tur gum lce ma dang*/ /ba ṭi ri kā dzaṃ gha mo/ /hor ba kaṃ ka mo de bzhin/ /dat+ta ri mo ri dwags dgra/ /thams cad kyang sngo ljang phyed pa'i sna tshogs pa'i kha dog bkra ba can no/ /sa'i 'khor lo la/ seng ge mo dang stag mo dang*/ /bhiṃ pa mo dang ri bong ma/ /glang chen ri dwags byi la mo/ /ba dang ma he mo rta mo/ /lce spyang mo dang bse mo 'bri/ /byi ba bong mo bhe ṭi ma/ /ra mo lug mo rim pa bzhin/ khyi mo phag mo dom mo dang*/ /daṇ+ḍa di ma mo dz+nyā kī/ /dred mo dang ni sgeg mo dang*/ /nags ma dang ni khyi chen mo/ /bya rog chen mo shar du lī/ /sprul mo khra mo rnga mong dang*/ /sre mong rtsang mo phug pa mo/ /grong na gnas pa ma rnams so/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog ser po'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi snam bu la/ de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa dang dpal sbas nas brtsams te/ sangs rgyas tshangs pa'i tog gi bar dus sangs rgyas nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'o/ /shar sgor tshangs ma/ byang sgor dbang phyug ma/ nub sgor gzhon nu ma/ lho sgor khyab 'jug ma/ mer phag mo/ bden bral du dbang mo/ rlung du gtum mo/ dbang ldan du dpal chen mo rnams so/ /me'i 'khor lo la/ lha mo klu mo gnod sbyin mo/ /'byung mo ma dang chung ma sring/ /bu mo sring mo'i bu mo dang*/ /pha yi sring mo de bzhin du/ /zhang po yi ni chung ma dang*/ /chung ma'i spun zla dang de'i ma/ /de nyid kyi ni ma yi ma/ /chung ma yi ni phyi mo dang*/ /ma yi ma dang gnyen mo dang*/ /ma'i spun spun zla'i bu mo dang*/ /rang gi phyi mo'i spun zla dang*/ /spun zla'i bu mo de'i bu mo/ /pha yi ma dang phyi mo dang*/ khu bo yi ni chung ma dang*/ /bu mo'i bu yi chung ma dang*/ /slar yang chung ma'i spun zla

mo/ /pha yi sring dang de'i bu mo/ /de nyid kyi ni rang rigs skyes/ /spun zla'i chung ma su tṝ dang*/ /bu nyid kyi ni chung ma dang*/ /bu mo'i khyo yi ma yi ni/ /bu nyid kyi ni rgyug mo dang*/ /'jo byed mo dang sū tri'o/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo'o/ /chu'i 'khor lo ma/ ma ka ra mo kurmī nya/ /sbal mo kats+tshi chu sram mo/ /sdig nag gag+ga ri ma shrī li ma/ /chu yi phug ma srin bu'i gdong ma dang*/ /cha ga kat+ka ṭa dang su ya mo/ /chu byi mo dang grog mo'i gdong ma dang*/ /chu yi mi mo dang ni ba ḍa bī/ /glang chen mo dang stag mo lce spyang mo/ /chu sbrul ma dang dud mo 'gron bu ma/ /mu tig ma ṇī mo dang dziṃ gu rī/ /li sa mo dang dud du ra ma kar+ṇo ṭi/ /pha ṭa ka ma dā wa ka ma kri ma mo/ /dzu ṣi dzu ṣa mo dang sha sbrang ka lā mo/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar mo'o/ /ye shes kyi 'khor lo la/ thig le mchog ma shin tu bde/ /lha yi bu mo dga' chen mo/ /dga' dang dga' grags pad+ma can/ /dung can sna tshogs glang chen ma/ /gzugs can ma dang gzugs mdzes ma/ /'dod chags rnams sgeg bde ba mo/ /me tog 'dod ma kun mud da/ /ut+pal ma dang mdzes ldan ma/ /'dod chags mo dang 'dod chags che/ /rol grags ma dang rol chen mo/ /myos ma dang ni myos chen ma/ /'dod pa mo dang 'dod chen ma/ /bde 'byung ma dang bde ldan ma/ /mthun mchog ma dang byams pa mo/ /skal bzang ldan ma skal bzang mo/ /dma' mo zhu ma skye gzugs ma/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog sna tshogs bkra ba'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi snam bu la/ de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i gzugs dang 'od 'phro nas sangs rgyas mthu'i dpal gyi bar du sangs rgyas nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe dgu'o/ /sgo mtshams brgyad la/ shar du gau rī/ byang du tsau rī/ nub tu be ta lī/ lho ru ghasma rī/ bsreg zar puk+ka sī/ srin por ri khrod ma/ rlung mtshams su tsaṇ+ḍa lī/

/'byung bor ḍom+bhi nī rnams so/ thugs kyi 'khor lo la/ klu mo gnod sbyin mo 'byung mo/ /yi dwags dmyal mo mnar med ma/ /ltung ba ma dang bar med ma/ /bum pa mo dang gshin rje mo/ /thig nag mo dang me mdag mo/ /tsha ma ba dang rab tsha ma/ /ngu 'bod ma dang ngu 'bod che/ /mar nag du 'tshed ri gnyis 'tshir/ /sdang ma rmongs ma phrag dog ma/ /chags ma ser snas myos pa ma/ /skud pa ma dang grang ba ma/ /de bzhin ral gri'i nags ma nyid/ /ngu ma dang ni mu ge mo/ /nad dgon mtshon dgon chung dgon ma/ /ral gri'i so ma rab med ma/ /spu gri'i so ma 'khor lo can/ /grul bum ma ste so drug go /thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo la/ /le lo chos sems sgom pa mo/ /mchod sems bza' sems gnyid sems ma/ khyim sems bud med sems ma dang*/ /don sems ma dang sbyor bral ma/ /bu sems ma dang mya ngan ma/ /bsam gtan ma dang sngags zlos ma/ /ngo tsha nga rgyal gdung ba mo/ /sems can don gyi rgyur brtson ma/ /rgyal po sems ma gzhan gnod ma/ /ye shes thob ma dka' thub ma/ /rgas ma 'ching bar sems ma dang*/ /bde ma sdug ma mi dge ma/ /yod ma med ma nyid dang ni/ /bla ma sems ma 'gro ba mo/ /bzod ma mi bzod dal ma dang*/ /ngal gsos ma dang bkres sems ma/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo'o/ /

'di thams cad kyi mtshan gyi mthar sems pa ma zhes sbyor rgyu yin no/ / sku'i 'khor lo la 'khor los bsgyur ma rnams te/ rgyal chen bzhi'i rigs 'khor los bsgyur ma dang*/ /sum cu rtsa gsum 'thab bral dga' ldan pa/ /'phrul dga' gzhan 'phrul dbang byed tshangs ris pa/ /tshangs pa mdun na 'don dang tshangs chen po/ /'od chung tshad med 'od dang 'od gsal ba/ /dge chung tshad med dge dang dge rgyas dang*/ /sprin med bsod nams skyes dang 'bras bu che/ /mi che mi gdung shin tu mthong ba dang*/ /gya nom snang ba dang ni 'og min pa/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas rnam shes mtha' yas dang*/ /ci yang med dang 'du shes yod min zhing*/ /'du shes med min gyi ni skye mched dang*/ /dmyal ba yi dwags dur 'gro dang ni mi/ /lha min zla ba nyi ma gshin rje dang*/ /dbang po'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba zhes rnams so/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar ba'am/ sngo dmar dkar ba'i khra bo'o/ /'di thams cad kyi mthar 'khor los bsgyur ma zhes sbyor ba yin no/ /de'i phyi rol gyi snam bu la/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'phags dgyes dang mthu stobs nas sangs rgyas snang mdzad kyi bar gyi sangs rgyas nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'o/ /shar sgor dkar mo chu skyes/ byang sgor gan+dha ri/ nub sgor rdo rje gar ma/ lho sgor rta rgod ma'i kha ma/ dbang ldan du rdo rje'i 'bar zhal ma/ mer rdo rje khro gnyer can ma/ bden bral du rdo rje dum bu ma/ rlung du rdo rje gtum mo rnams so/ /de rnams las 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi rnal 'byor ma thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum/ dang po gnyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /lhag ma gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ drag mo chen mo mche ba gtsigs shing chags pas bzhad pa/ gcer mo skra grol zhing phyag lnga dang rdo rje'i 'phreng ba sogs sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ de rnams la 'khyud pa'i dpa' bo rnams ni/

mtshan dang sku'i rnam pa yum dang 'dra ba las/ phyag rgya drug dang ral ba'i cod pan dang*/ mgo rlon gyi do shal dang*/ stag lpags kyi smad dkris can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa bzhi'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni/ shar phyogs pa rnams sngo ba/ byang phyogs pa rnams ljang ba/ nub phyogs pa rnams dmar ba/ lho phyogs pa rnams ser ba/ me mtshams pa rnams g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ bden bral pa rnams g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ rlung mtshams pa rnams g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ dbang ldan pa rnams g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig= nas mtshungs pa'o/ /bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas rnams ni/ shar phyogs pa rnams sngon po/ byang phyogs pa rnams ljang khu/ nub phyogs pa rnams dmar po/ lho phyogs pa rnams ser po/ thams cad kyang mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs pa chags bral rab byung gi cha lugs can bzhugs tshul dang phyag rgya ma nges pa'o/ / zhes bla ma snga ma rnams gsung*/ de dag ni dam tshig gi 'khor lo bskyed pa'o/ / gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūṃ ljang sngon/ spyi bor zla ba dang 'khor lo la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par zla ba dang pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ thugs ka'i 'og gi cha la zla ba dang rdo rje la gnas pa'i hūṃ nag po/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar nyi ma rang rang gi kha dog dang mtshungs pa'i hūṃ yig go /gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūṃ yig gnyis kyi bar du raṃ las byung ba'i nyi ma'i steng du/ oṃ ha baṃ hā bāṃ hi bi hī bīṃ/ hu buṃ hūṃ būṃ/ he beṃ hai baiṃ/ ho boṃ hau bauṃ/ haṃ baṃ haḥbaḥ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā swāhā/ dkar po dang dmar po g.yas skor du sbrul 'khyil ba ltar gnas pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' phag mo'i rang bzhin no/ go cha'i sngags drug char la 'gor oṃ dang*/ 'jug tu hūṃ bzhi phaṭa bzhi swāhā gnyis rnams gong bzhin sbyar dgos te/ mgo bo'i nang du nyi ma la/

nāṃ haṃ nā hāṃ/ nu huṃ nū hūṃ/ ne heṃ nā+ai haiṃ/ no ho nau hauṃ/ na haṃ nāḥhāḥ ser po dang sngon po rnam par snang mdzad dang gshin rje ma'i ngo bo/ spyi gtsug gi nang du nyi ma la/ swa hraṃ swā hrāṃ/ swi hriṃ swāṃ hrī/ swu hruṃ swū hrūṃ/ swe hraṃ swaiṃ hraiṃ/ swo hroṃ swau hrā+au/ swa hraṃ swaḥhraḥ dmar po dang dkar po pad+ma gar dbang dang rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo/ dpung pa gnyis kyi nang du nyi ma la/ ba hraṃ bā hrāṃ/ bi hriṃ bī hrīṃ/ bu huṃ bū hūṃ/ be hreṃ bai hraiṃ/ bo hroṃ bau hrauṃ/ ba hraṃ baḥhraḥ nag po dang ser po he ru ka dang skyong byed ma'i ngo bo/ mig gnyis kyi dbus su nyi ma la/ ha haṃ hū hūṃ/ hi hiṃ hū hūṃ/ hu hūṃ hū hūṃ/ he he hai haiṃ/ ho hoṃ hau hauṃ/ haṃ haṃ haḥhaḥ dmar ser dang ljang khu rdo rje nyi ma dang skrag byed ma'i ngo bo/ mdzod spu'i thad ka'i nang du/ pha pha phā phā/ phi phi phī phī/ phu phu phū phū/ phe phe phai phai/ pho pho phau phau/ phaṃ phaṃ/ phaḥphaḥ ljang khu dang dud kha rta mchog dang tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo/ 'di la'ang pha phaṃ phā phāṃ sogs dgos par mngon yang sngar gyi dpe thams cad la med par mthun pas re zhig bzhag go / 'di rnams las yi ge'i tshogs 'phros/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad sngags kyi rdul phra rab kyis gang*/ sku lus kyi phyi rol du snying gar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hu dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /phrag pa gnyis su bo ṣaṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka /mig gnyis su hūṃ hūṃ hoḥdamar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ oṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ /dpral par hreṃ hriṃ ser mo skyong byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/

yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo'o/ /de rnams las yi ge'i tshogs 'phros te lus kyi phyi rol thams cad gang bar gyur/ 'dir yang spro na go cha'i lha rnams zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du bsgom ste/ lū yi pa'i lugs bzhin no/ /snying ga'i sa bon 'od zer gyis bskul nas/ gdod ma nas grub pa'i dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor chen po mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral par skor zhing phaiṃ zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra wā nī= sogs rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zha ེsa pas dam ye bsre/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyis 'od zer gyis bskul bas/ dbang lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yab yum la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ phai+eṃ gong bzhin rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams khrus gsol ltar/ /de bzhin bdag la khrus byed 'gyur/ /lha yi chus ni dag par mdzod/ /ces gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lnga yab yum snyoms bar zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba sbyor ba mtshams nas byung nas/ bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i rgyun gyis lha thams cad kyi spyi bo nas blugs shing dbang bskur bas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag rdo rje bzhi mi phyed pa'i rang bzhin du byin gyis rlabs/ spyi bo'i steng du gnas pa'i bdud rtsi'i thigs pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag por gyur pa ni/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje phag mo la 'od dpag med/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo pa dang*/ nam mkha'i 'khor lo pa dang*/ thugs 'khor pa rnams la mi bskyod pa snying po'i 'khor lo pa dang*/ me'i 'khor lo pa dang*/ gsung gi 'khor lo pa rnams la 'od dpag med/

yon tan gyi 'khor lo pa dang*/ chu'i 'khor lo pa dang*/ sku'i 'khor lo pa rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ sna tshogs thig le'i 'khor lo la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*/ sa'i 'khor lo rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/ rlung gi 'khor lo pa dang*/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo pa dang*/ sgo mtshams ma rnams la don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing dbang gi lha rnams rigs bdag la thim/ de nas mchod pa dngos su bshams yod na byin rlabs bya/ yid sprul tsam la byin rlabs mi dgos te/ gang ltar yang gong tshogs bsog gi skabs su bshad pa ltar chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga rig ma bcu drug rnams kyis mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin= zhes pa nas/ g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa dang*/ /bde chen sogs dang bzang po dang*/ /gnyis kun rnam par spangs pa dang*/ /mchod pa khams gsum bdag nyid ni/ /dngos po kun 'byung rnams kyis mchod/ / de nas bstod pa ni/ cang te'u sogs rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ rkang pa zhe brgyad pa'i mthar/ he ru ka dpal ye shes che/ /rnal 'byor chen po thub chen po/ / zhes pa nas/ stong pa'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'i bar gyi mtshan brgyas kyang bstod/ nang mchod 'bru gsum gyis myangs la/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma ma lus pa 'dus nas/ myos byed dang sha'i bye brag sna tshogs pa dang dam tshig gi rdzas thams cad kyis mchod de thams cad kyang rang gi snying gar thim/ dkyil 'khor bde ba chen po bsgom par gyis/ /rnal 'byor bcu gnyis bsod nams sdig med pa/ /thams cad zag med rang bzhin myong bar gyis/ /dkyil 'khor ngan pa de ni bde bar shes par byos/ /dbang po 'khrul pa bde ba chen por myong bar gyis/ /skad cig de la rang dang gzhan gyi ngo bo

zhes pa yab kyi rtsa ba'i sngags 'di nyid dang*/ yum gyi rtsa ba'i sngags te/ bzlas bya'i gtso bo ni 'di gnyis yin la/ de tsam bzla ba mi lcogs na rtsa sngags gnyis po tshar gcig bton nas/ yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying gang mos pa zhig bzla bar bya'o/ /'khor gyi sngags rnams ni/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i skabs bzla mi dgos la/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa la sogs pa'i gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu dgos mod kyi gzhan du bri bar bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdu ba ni/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang brgyad dam mtshan brgya gang rung gis bstod dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi rol gyi me'i rwa ba nas brtsams bdag nyid kyi bar du phyi ma phyi ma nang ma nang ma la thim/ rang nyid kyang snying ga'i hūṃ ljang sngon la thim/ de yang nā da'i bar du bsdus te nā da yang dbyings su thim par gyur/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag stong pa'i ngang las bdag dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gzugs kyis gnas par gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas dag pa dran pa mdor bsdus pa ni/ kun rdzob dang ni don dam pa/ /dkyil 'khor pa dang gtso bo'o/ khrag 'thung gnyis med dngos po ru/ /'di gsum gyis ni khams gsum mo/ /thams cad thig le'i gzugs bdag nyid/ /bden pa gnyis su bzung ba med/ /yod pa gzugs med bdag nyid de/ /rtog pa tsam du khyab bdag che/ /sbyin pa kun rdzob gzugs bdag nyid/ /pha rol yang ni don dam pa'o/ /dang po'i sbyor ba des 'grub bo/ /tshul khrims bsnyen pa sogs su 'dod/ /phar phyin rgyu yi rdo rje 'chang*/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid do/ /bzod pa tshangs par spyod pa yi/ / dkyil 'khor 'byin pa yang ni de/ /rgyal po bde ba kun la gnas/ /mchog ni rang gi pha rol phyin/ /brtson 'grus dga' chen thams cad las/ /mdog dang bzhugs tshul bdag nyid kyis/ /pha rol phyin rnams rang bzhin du/ /ye shes rnam par kun tu 'byung*/

/ye shes sems sogs bsam gtan te/ /phar phyin 'od zer spro ba'o/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor dang dbang bskur/ /shes rab las kyi rgyal po mchog /rang rang mgo bor rigs kyis ni/ /rgyas btab pha rol phyin pa'o/ /stobs ni snying rje'i dpa' bo ste/ /stong pa nyid ni rnal 'byor ma/ /pha rol phyin ma gnyis med kun/ /g.yon par zhugs skyes gang bde ba/ /thabs ni thig le'i rnal 'byor te/ /pha rol phyin pa theg pa che/ /smon lam sngags kyi bzlas pa sogs/ /phar phyin phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /phag mo dang ni bsres pa las/ /bsdu ba pha rol phyin pa ste/ /'jig rten khams kyi rnam dag pa'o/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das gzugs bdag /sgyu ma snying rje las byung ba'o/ /thams cad bden min rdzun min pa'o/ /skye min mi skye min spangs pa'o/ / zhes so/ /gong du bshad pa bzhin lus kyi phyi'i go cha rnams bkod nas/ snying gar oṃ dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'= zhes pa nas/ thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ sum+bha= sogs mtshams rngam bya/ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku'i rang bzhin/ zhes sogs lū nag dang mthun par brjod/ snang ba thams cad lhar mos bzhin du dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga la gtor ma byin rlabs ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na la ho bha ga wā na badz+ra rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes pas sbyangs/ stong pa'i las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūṃ las byung ba'i mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du a las byung ba'i thod pa dum bu gsum pa/

phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ de'i nang gi shar du oṃ dkar po las dri chen oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang du khaṃ ljang khu las sha chen gyi dngas ma khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ nub tu aṃ dmar po las byang chub kyi sems aṃ gis mtshan pa/ lhor traṃ ser po las rak+ta traṃ gis mtshan pa/ dbus su hūṃ sngon po las dri chu hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ /mer laṃ dkar po las ba lang gi sha laṃ gis mtshan pa/ bden bral du māṃ sngon po las khyi'i sha māṃ gyis mtshan pa/ rlung du baṃ dmar po las glang po'i sha pāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ dbang ldan du tāṃ ljang khu las rta'i sha tāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ dbus su bāṃ dmar po las sha chen bāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ 'og gi rlung g.yos me 'bar bas/ rdzas bcu yi ge dang bcas pa zhu ba nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog ltar dmar ser gsal la dwangs par gyur pa'i steng thad du/ hūṃ yig las byung ba'i kha ṭ+waṃ ga dkar po byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can mgo bo thur du lta ba/ de las bdud rtsi dkar po babs te/ der lhungs pa g.yon skor du lan gsum dkrugs shing zhu bas dngul chu'i mdog can shin tu bsil ba'i bdud rtsir gyur/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la/ oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa tha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha pa bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa rnams kha dog sna tshogs pa yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūṃ sngon po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ de las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha dang bcas pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phros/ rgya mtsho la sogs pa na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dpa' mo thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi bkug cing*/ 'gro ba rnams 'khor gsum gyi lhar byas pa rnams spyan drangs/ snyoms 'jug gi bde bas zhu/ de thams cad yig 'bru gsum la thim/ oṃ āḥhūṃ yang rim pas bdud rtsi zhu ba gtor ma la thim pas/

kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum ste byin gyis rlabs pa'o/ /de nas mgron spyan drangs shing gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rnam pa thams cad kyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs phyi rol phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral par bskor zhing*/ pheṭa ces brjod/ rang gi mdun gyi chos 'byung gi nang du pad+ma'i gdan la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yang dag par bzhugs shing*/ phyogs skyong ba la sogs pa phyi rol du 'khod par gyur/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs rnams skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug nas/ dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ de nas chu gnyis nyer spyod rigs bcu drug lha mo brgyad rnams kyis mchod/ lag pa g.yon du ā li las zla ba/ g.yas su kā li las nyi ma/ dbus su hūṃ/ nyi zla hūṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur ba rdo rje thal mor gyur/ oṃ a no n+ya a nu ga tāḥ sarba dharmāḥpa ra spa re/ a nu pra preṣ+ta sarba dharmāḥ.a r+yan+ta/ a nu pra pṛṣ+ta sarba dharmāḥhūṃ/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang nas rgyur gyur cig mgron rnams kyis ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a ral+li hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa mā ya s+t+waṃ/ /dṛ bya hoḥ zhes pa lan gsum dang oṃ bha k+ṣa bha k+ṣa sarba yo ga yo gī shwa re hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥswāhā/ zhes pa lan lngas dkyil 'khor pa rnams la phul/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bhu bā ya swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra hā sa a+ya swāhā/ zhes pas so rtsi dang na bza' phul/ gong bzhin zhabs bsil kyang phul/ rkang pa bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa dang*/

rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa= zhes pa nas/ bdag la rjes brtser mdzad du gsol gyi bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ de nas 'jig rten pa rnams la 'bul ba ni/ rdo rje thal mo gyen du kha phye la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta prā+e ta bi sha tsa/ u na ma d+ya/ a pasmā ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i maṃ bā liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tshan+ta/ ya thai baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+taṃ/ bhuñja tha/ pi pa tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba karta ya/ sat+su khaṃ/ bi bṛd+dha/ sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyis phul/ zhing skyong rnams la khyad par gyis 'bul ba ni/ oṃ kak+ka dha naṃ/ bab+bhan+dha naṃ/ khakh+kha da naṃ/ sarba duṣ+taṃ/ ha na ha na/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ ma ma kar+yaṃ ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ ha ho hri swāhā zhes pas nang mchod phul/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang = zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces pas bstod cing 'dod don gsol ba btab/ dril bu rgyun dkrol du byed cing*/ 'gro ba kun ni mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin te/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gnas kyi/ /a re re re gti mug phyugs kyis mi shes so/ /lhan skyes mdzes ma blangs nas bde ba che la mnos/ /sham+bhu sa gsum ma lus 'gro ba sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin/ /snying rje'i gzhon nu ma dang lhan cig rol par byos/ /a re/ gang gi don dam la ni ma bsgoms pas/ /de yis sangs rgyas nyid ni thob pa ma yin no/ /a re/ nang dang phyi ni dbye ba med par shes par gyis/ /'jig rten thams cad bsgral bar nus pa'o/ /a re/ de nas yig brgya lan mang du brjod/ mig gi phyag rgya bstan la/ pad skor sngon du 'gro ba lte bar 'khyud rgya byas pa'i mthar se gol gtogs te/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ dkyil 'khor pa bdag gi smin mtshams su thim/

'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ skabs 'dir/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dus la gus pas mchod pa dang sogs sh+lau ka gnyis kyis smon lam gdab par bshad pa ni/ tshogs dang gtor ma lhan cig tu byed pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ tshogs 'khor gyi bya ba dang ma 'brel bar gtor ma rkyang pa la ni/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad nad med par/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'gro ba yi/ /lam de nyid du 'grub gyur cig /ma sgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par bgyi/ / zhes sogs smon lam ci rigs par gdab cing*/ bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs kyang blang bar bya'o/ /'di ni rgyun gyi nyams len gyi gtor chog ste bsdus pa yin zhing*/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'am/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma chen po dang*/ zhing skyong gi gtor ma rnams ni/ lha'i bskyed chog shin tu rgyas pas/ 'dir ma bris te shes par 'dod na gzhan du blta bar bya'o/ / 'di las dge ba gang thob pa/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /bdag kyang de ring phan chad du/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa nyid du shog / de la dkyil 'khor de nyid kyi sgrub thabs shin tu mang po rnams phal cher tshig tshogs che ba lhur blangs pas/ deng sang phan thogs chung bar mthong zhing*/ tshigs bcad du sdebs pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa 'ga' zung yang snang mod kyi/ go dka' zhing ngag 'don dang sgom don gyi dbye ba phyed dka' ba dang*/ yang sgrub thabs 'ga' zhig la dgos pa'i don chad pa yang snang bas/ nyung ngu rnam gsal yang dag rdzogs/ /zhes pa'i tshul du byas pa yin no/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs mtha' rgyas don mtha' dag ma tshang ba med pa la tshig zor shin tu yang bar byas pa 'di yang*/ tā ra nā thā'i rol rtsed do/ zhu dag maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/
